authentication: Existing Supabase JWT. Resolve user on server. No user_id parameter or service role in client.

new_ai_mode.compatibility: Keep existing chat and extract modes unchanged.

rpcs.name: campus_butler_snapshot
rules: Owner only. Distinguish available empty, missing, unconfirmed and unavailable.
No unfiltered all-campus activity feed in relevant_events.

rpcs.name: campus_save_timetable

p_client_request_id.semantics: One operation; reuse on retry; changed body with same id must fail.

rules: Payload matches existing version-1 timetable format.
Only explicit user import; no automatic guest or other-account overwrite.
course_locations: array of course_id/location_id/confirmed_by_user.

rpcs.name: campus_save_butler_preferences

p_client_request_id.semantics: One operation; reuse on retry; changed body with same id must fail.

rules: Allow only time_zone/goals/free_windows/quiet_enabled/quiet_start/quiet_end/important_bypass_quiet/blocked_topics.
Keep favorites and interests in existing campus_notification_preferences.
Cleared goals/free_windows must no longer be model context.

rpcs.name: campus_upsert_personal_task

p_client_request_id.semantics: One operation; reuse on retry; changed body with same id must fail.

rules: p_task allows id/client_id/title/kind/status/start_at/end_at/due_at/location_id/allow_conflict.
No client-supplied source provenance or user_id.
For new manual tasks id is null and expected version is 0; server binds source_type=user_request.
Hard conflict requires explicit allow_conflict=true for manual entry; plan confirmation never bypasses conflicts.

rpcs.name: campus_confirm_plan

p_client_request_id.semantics: One operation; reuse on retry; changed body with same id must fail.

rules: Owner, expiry, current source versions, selected draft IDs and conflicts rechecked in one transaction.
p_items allows draft_item_id/title/start_at/end_at/due_at/location_id only.
No partial success. Same confirmed draft returns original task IDs, even with another request ID.

rpcs.name: campus_start_matter

p_client_request_id.semantics: One operation; reuse on retry; changed body with same id must fail.

rules: Input allows source_type/source_id/kind/user_reported_state/next_follow_up_at.
source_type report/event/service_guide; report must belong to current user; guides published and events readable.
Unique owner/source. Steps and provenance are copied from validated server source.

rpcs.name: campus_set_matter_state

p_client_request_id.semantics: One operation; reuse on retry; changed body with same id must fail.

rules: Stop does not withdraw or resolve the source report/event.
For actual lost-item recovery call existing campus_set_report_status first; personal completion alone is not official source completion.
Cancel queued follow-ups; workers must recheck source state.

rpcs.name: campus_set_matter_step

p_client_request_id.semantics: One operation; reuse on retry; changed body with same id must fail.

rules: Only current owner steps; mark evidence_source=user_reported, not official receipt.

rpcs.name: campus_record_recommendation_feedback

p_client_request_id.semantics: One operation; reuse on retry; changed body with same id must fail.

rules: Target must be readable by owner. Does not suppress confirmed important public notices.

rpcs.name: campus_delete_recommendation_feedback

p_client_request_id.semantics: One operation; reuse on retry; changed body with same id must fail.

rules: Only owner. Remove reason/derived recommendation use and invalidate caches; idempotent.

error_transport_note: HTTP mappings are gateway targets; provide stable SQLSTATE/business-code mapping for RPC without assuming custom PostgREST HTTP behavior.
